# FilterToolbar

A filter summary bar that renders active filters as dismissable `Tag` elements grouped by category, and hides itself automatically when no filters are active.

```ts
import { FilterToolbar } from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

## Basic Usage

Each `FilterGroup` in `filters` renders its `label` followed by individual `Tag` elements for each active option. Clicking the × icon on a tag calls `onDeleteTag`; clicking "Clear All" calls `onClearAll`.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { FilterToolbar } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

const INITIAL_FILTERS = [
  {
    key: 'status',
    label: 'Status',
    options: [
      { id: 'active', value: 'Active' },
      { id: 'inactive', value: 'Inactive' },
    ],
  },
  {
    key: 'team',
    label: 'Team',
    options: [
      { id: 'support', value: 'Support' },
      { id: 'sales', value: 'Sales' },
    ],
  },
];

export default function Demo() {
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState(INITIAL_FILTERS);

  const handleDeleteTag = (filterKey, optionId) => {
    setFilters((prev) =>
      prev.map((group) =>
        group.key === filterKey
          ? {
              ...group,
              options: group.options.filter((o) => o.id !== optionId),
            }
          : group
      )
    );
  };

  const handleClearAll = () => {
    setFilters((prev) => prev.map((group) => ({ ...group, options: [] })));
  };

  return (
    <Box width="100%">
      <FilterToolbar
        filters={filters}
        onDeleteTag={handleDeleteTag}
        onClearAll={handleClearAll}
        data-qa="demo-filter-toolbar"
      />
    </Box>
  );
}
```

## Custom Labels

Use `filtersLabel` and `clearAllLabel` to localise or override the default English strings.

```tsx preview
import { FilterToolbar } from '@wfm/ui-components';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <FilterToolbar
      filters={[
        {
          key: 'priority',
          label: 'Prioridad',
          options: [
            { id: 'high', value: 'Alta' },
            { id: 'low', value: 'Baja' },
          ],
        },
      ]}
      filtersLabel="Filtros"
      clearAllLabel="Borrar todo"
      onDeleteTag={() => {}}
      onClearAll={() => {}}
    />
  );
}
```

## Empty State (renders null)

When all filter groups have no active options, the component returns `null` and occupies no space.

```tsx preview
import { FilterToolbar, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Box padding={4}>
      <Typography variant="caption">
        No active filters — FilterToolbar renders nothing below:
      </Typography>
      <FilterToolbar
        filters={[{ key: 'status', label: 'Status', options: [] }]}
        onDeleteTag={() => {}}
        onClearAll={() => {}}
      />
    </Box>
  );
}
```

## maxRender — Overflow Badge

Set `maxRender` to limit how many tags are shown per group. Tags beyond the limit collapse into a `+N` badge.

## Dividers

Use `isTopDivider` and `isBottomDivider` to render a 1 px Cobalt `Divider` above and/or below the toolbar. This is useful when the toolbar sits between sections that share the same `basic100` background and need a visual separator.

- `isTopDivider` — adds a divider above the tag row
- `isBottomDivider` — adds a divider below the tag row

```tsx preview
import { FilterToolbar, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';

const FILTERS = [
  {
    key: 'status',
    label: 'Status',
    options: [
      { id: 'active', value: 'Active' },
      { id: 'inactive', value: 'Inactive' },
    ],
  },
];

function Section({ label, children }) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  return (
    <Box
      width="100%"
      style={{ border: `1px solid ${theme.basic300}`, borderRadius: 4 }}
    >
      <Box padding={3} backgroundColor={theme.basic100}>
        <Typography variant="caption" color={theme.basic600}>
          {label}
        </Typography>
      </Box>
      {children}
      <Box padding={3}>
        <Typography variant="caption">Content below toolbar</Typography>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
}

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" gap="6" padding="4">
      <Section label="isTopDivider">
        <FilterToolbar
          isTopDivider
          filters={FILTERS}
          onDeleteTag={() => {}}
          onClearAll={() => {}}
        />
      </Section>
      <Section label="isBottomDivider">
        <FilterToolbar
          isBottomDivider
          filters={FILTERS}
          onDeleteTag={() => {}}
          onClearAll={() => {}}
        />
      </Section>
      <Section label="isTopDivider + isBottomDivider">
        <FilterToolbar
          isTopDivider
          isBottomDivider
          filters={FILTERS}
          onDeleteTag={() => {}}
          onClearAll={() => {}}
        />
      </Section>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Props

### FilterToolbar

| Prop              | Type                                            | Default              | Description                                              |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `filters`         | `FilterGroup[]`                                 | —                    | Array of filter groups to display                        |
| `onDeleteTag`     | `(filterKey: string, optionId: string) => void` | —                    | Called when a tag's × is clicked                         |
| `onClearAll`      | `() => void`                                    | —                    | Called when "Clear All" is clicked                       |
| `maxRender`       | `number`                                        | —                    | Hard cap on tags shown per group before overflow applies |
| `filtersLabel`    | `string`                                        | `"Filters"`          | Label before the filter groups                           |
| `clearAllLabel`   | `string`                                        | `"Clear All"`        | Text of the clear button                                 |
| `isTopDivider`    | `boolean`                                       | `false`              | Renders a 1 px Cobalt Divider above the toolbar          |
| `isBottomDivider` | `boolean`                                       | `false`              | Renders a 1 px Cobalt Divider below the toolbar          |
| `data-qa`         | `string`                                        | —                    | Test selector for the toolbar root                       |
| `data-component`  | `string`                                        | `"WFMFilterToolbar"` | Component identifier                                     |

### FilterGroup

| Prop      | Type             | Description                         |
| --------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `key`     | `string`         | Unique identifier for the group     |
| `label`   | `string`         | Display label shown before the tags |
| `options` | `FilterOption[]` | Active filter options               |

### FilterOption

| Prop    | Type     | Description              |
| ------- | -------- | ------------------------ |
| `id`    | `string` | Unique option identifier |
| `value` | `string` | Display text for the tag |
